description: This file defines the UserDemoData class used for creating and managing demo user data within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods to generate seed users, create user entries, and handle related data. The class interacts with external components like BeanFactory and User to perform database operations for user creation.

classes.name: UserDemoData
classes.description: A class to generate and manage demo user data for SuiteCRM, including creation of seed users and bulk demo user setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the demo data handler with a seed user and optional large-scale testing flag.

methods.name: create_demo_data
methods.description: Main method to create demo user data, including calling internal methods to create individual users.

methods.name: _create_seed_user
methods.description: Creates a seed user record in the database with specified attributes.

methods.name: _seed_data_get_user_list
methods.description: Returns a predefined list of user names for demo data purposes.

methods.name: _quick_create_user
methods.description: Creates a demo user quickly if it does not already exist, based on predefined data.
